```yaml
name: Autofix

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  push:
    branches: [ main ]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build-and-autofix:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Cancel previous runs
        uses: styfle/cancel-workflow-action@0.12.1
        with:
          workflow_id: ${{ github.workflow }}
          access_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js 24
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build project
        run: npm run all

      - name: Commit changes using autofix.ci
        uses: autofix-ci/action@v1
        with:
          commit-message: "chore(dist): update dist folder"
          git-ignored-authors: "renovate[bot],autofix.ci[bot]"
```
